# mentions

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:mentions`](gmeow-mentions.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/mentions>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notes`](../../slices/notes.md)

A note mentions another entity (typically another note or a resource) — the source of a directed backlink edge. Non-functional: a note may mention many entities. Kept cardinality-free for DL regularity; the inverse [`mentionedIn`](gmeow-mentionedIn.md) provides the backlink view.
